db_host_not_found.title: The server of {connection} couldn't be found
db_host_not_found.hint: Its host name doesn't resolve. Check the host in the connection, or whether the server was renamed or moved.

db_refused.title: The server of {connection} refused the connection
db_refused.hint: No database is listening on that host and port. Check the port in the connection and that the database service is running.

db_unreachable.title: The server of {connection} couldn't be reached
db_unreachable.hint: The network connection failed or timed out. Check that the server is up and reachable from the platform (firewall, VPN).

db_login.title: The database refused the login of {connection}
db_login.hint: The user name or password is wrong, expired or locked. Update the credentials in the connection.

db_timeout.title: The database took too long to answer ({connection})
db_timeout.hint: The statement hit its time limit. Try again later, or ask the database owner whether the server is busy or the query needs an index.

db_permission.title: The login of {connection} isn't allowed to do this
db_permission.hint: Ask the database owner to give the connection's login access to the tables it uses.

db_object_missing.title: A table or routine is missing in {connection}
db_object_missing.hint: The statement uses a table, view or procedure that doesn't exist or was renamed. Check the statement or the tables it uses.

db_sql.title: The database couldn't run the statement
db_sql.hint: The SQL has a syntax error. Check the statement.

db_data.title: A value didn't fit the target table
db_data.hint: A value is too long or has the wrong type for its column. Check the mapping and the transforms.

db_constraint.title: The database refused rows that break one of its rules
db_constraint.hint: A key is duplicated or a referenced row is missing. Check the keys and the data being written.

db_read_only.title: {connection} is read-only
db_read_only.hint: Writing needs a connection that allows it. Pick another connection or ask an administrator.

db_other.title: The database returned an error ({connection})
db_other.hint: The technical details show the server's message.

connection_disabled.title: The connection {connection} is turned off
connection_disabled.hint: An administrator turned it off. Turn it on again in Database connections, or use another connection.

http_status.title: {host} answered {status} instead of {expected}
http_status.hint: {class, select, server {The service had a problem on its side. It usually recovers: try again later.} other {Check the address, the credentials and the request.}}

http_unreachable.title: {host} couldn't be reached
http_unreachable.hint: The address doesn't resolve or the server didn't answer. Check the URL and that the service is up.

http_timeout.title: {host} didn't answer in time
http_timeout.hint: The service is slow or down. Try again later, or allow more time for the request.

blocked.title: The address isn't allowed
blocked.hint: The platform doesn't call private or internal addresses unless an administrator allows the host.

timeout.title: The run took longer than its limit of {seconds, number} s
timeout.hint: Allow more time in the job's settings, or make the work smaller.

cancelled.title: The run was cancelled
cancelled.hint: Someone stopped it, or it was cancelled before it started.

lost.title: The worker stopped responding during the run
lost.hint: The platform restarted or a worker stopped. Run it again; if it keeps happening, ask an administrator to check the workers.

script_exit.title: The script ended with error code {code}
script_exit.hint: The log shows the script's own message.

sandbox_unavailable.title: Scripts can't run right now
sandbox_unavailable.hint: No script runner is set up or it isn't available. Ask an administrator.

remote_auth.title: {connection} refused the stored credentials
remote_auth.hint: Update the credentials in the connection, then test it.

remote_rejected.title: The other system refused the change
remote_rejected.hint: The technical details show its message.

remote_rate_limited.title: The other system is limiting requests
remote_rate_limited.hint: The work continues by itself after a pause.

not_found.title: What this run works on no longer exists
not_found.hint: It was deleted. Edit the job to pick another one, or delete the job.

invalid.title: The settings of this work aren't valid any more
invalid.hint: Edit it and save again: the form shows what to fix.

other.title: The run failed
other.hint: The technical details show the error.

runLog.title: Log
runLog.live: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} · live

inUse.title: Still used by
inUse.summary: Still used by {first}{more, plural, =0 {} other { and # more}}.
